note: Round 3 (STE-304): does a theme brief plus history-aware repeat filtering handle real player themes (broad, narrow, academic, time-sensitive) better than Guardian as is? Themes chosen with the owner. Each theme is generated for 3 simulated games; only game 1 goes on the owner's sheet, later games measure repeats.

arms.label: T: Guardian + theme brief + repeat filter
